sameDayRetelling: Elian took my new clarity-and-silence rules down to D28, where the Lurker Queen that had confused and killed Dara fell in three turns ('clarity potion · clear · silence scroll · silent · LURKER QUEEN DOWN'). He pushed through the sanctum carrying $17k to the Mirror King at D33. The King's mirrored blows took him from 45 to 2 hp and my 30% return rule fired one hit too late, losing $3969 but teaching me the King's counter.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: Death lines and traces are readable ('Bryn · fell to jackal, D13 · throw fire vs gas backfired'), but several misreads: 'THIS EDIT · death 25→75%' shown right after a forge buy, rule warning 'also matches: goblin, bloat' on a foe: boss rule, 'starving −37' never explained in any report, and details saying 'King · slain' while the reel says 'The Mirror King waits... Returned'.

Real foreseeable trade-offs in the pen: deep-return 40%→30% read 'D29 13→75% · death 13→63% · $6600–15900/run' and I chose the risk; return picks (drill/legacy/forge −40%) were defensible. But tactic compares repeatedly read 'close · turns on D23 Master' for every option and forge buys were strictly ordered.

Visible learning: from dying to the Queen ('confused', 'none beats 0/12') to beating her with my clarity+silence rules; but much of the depth came from automatic gear/worker spikes (D8→D23 in one run after forging) and I never learned how to stop 'starving'.

Chosen stakes resolved on screen: Master fight at '14/51 hp' with $1.6k carried, lost '$2737' pack after picking the risky threshold, King at '2/46 hp'. Lapses: many runs ended on safe 'hurt · went home' returns at D13/D23 with nothing at risk, and long 'Heading home' stretches deflate it.

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: Automatic speed chips ('quiet · 48×', 'fight · 2×', 'scene · 1.3×') keep fights at readable speed and callouts like 'REFLECTED!', 'SPLITS!', 'POPS!' land; but there were ~20–30 s stretches of nothing and a ~2 min 'Heading home' on D13; sprites are muddy and an item row overlaps the hero. Audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: Distinct situations changed my configuration: Bloat Mother gas, Foundry Master 'REFLECTED!', siren confusion making every rule 'confused', Mirror King mirrors; six biomes (burrows, fens, crypt, foundry, deep, sanctum). Lapse: early floors D1–22 repeat identically every run (later skipped as 'D1–22 swift').

The final set is recognisably mine ('foe: boss · depth ≥ 27 → drink clarity', 'foe: boss · depth ≥ 28 → read silence', 'depth ≥ 13 · foe: boss → throw fire'), on a Guarded/Mirror-rhythm fighter; but only 5 slots and package rows ('[card] boss focus') sit below mine and cannot be reordered (disabled ▲).

Runs yield anecdotes with a turn: 'Fenn · fell to the King, D33 · pack $3953 on D33 · read silence vs boss backfired'; grudges ('grudge: Skix the jackal', 'avenged Zelak'). Lapse: the report reel is generic ('The nest wakes.' 'Returned with $2419.') and the Chronicle button opened nothing.

axes.proxy: run length; check-in length; dead time at 1x
axes.note: In-run: fights are brisk, but dead stretches ('quiet · 48×' ~20 s; 'Heading home' ~2 min on D13). Check-in admin: many sheets (forge, supplies, tactics, unlocks, quest, workers, legacy) and the dock moved ('quest' appeared where 'edit' was). Cadence: 20m/4h/8h returns were distinct (1/3/7 runs).

axes.proxy: share of deaths with a matched-rule trace
axes.note: Every death named cause, rule and margin in one screen ('the Master · D23 · hero at 1/45 hp', 'tactic boss focus fired' trace, 'fixes · 12 replays of D23 · survives 11/12 · was 1/12'), recovery was a heir and a tap. Lapse: confusion death offered 'none beats 0/12 as is', and money line 'died $1734 · $566 lost' was hard to parse.
Weight 0 in idle-hybrid. Only named heirs and 'Ashusk · old hound · served Wren, Yara, Alden'.

I set my own goal (counter the Queen myself) and chose risk levels; quests ('reach D8 · no return'), bounties ('bounty D28 · 2× gold') and route ('D5 burrows · D9 fens · D14 crypt') exist, though the route was never a choice I had to make.

D4 → D33 in ~66 min with automation growth at a legible cadence (porter 'hauled $4984', scout 'sent 7', apprentice, drillmaster, armourer) and vocabulary growth (identified potions/scrolls became actions). Lapse: Legacy rank 1 cost 15 then 'Upgrade 600' — a cliff — and one run jumped D8→D23 flattening the curve.

Torch-lit pixel town at night, parchment sheets and the red 'YOU DIED' banner are atmospheric; but every heir uses the same portrait, dungeon sprites are muddy at phone scale, and the item bar covers the hero. Audio unassessed.
